title: Event-Driven Digital-Time-Domain Inference Architectures for Tsetlin Machines
new_feature: Event-driven asynchronous (two-phase bundled-data click-element) TM inference with class-sum and argmax moved to the time domain: Hamming-distance delay accumulation plus Winner-Takes-All arbitration for multi-class TM, and differential sign/magnitude delay paths with leading-ones-detector logarithmic delay compression for the signed weights of the Coalesced TM.

datasets.split_as_reported: not stated; used for functional verification (a short input sequence giving target classes 2,0,1,1)

extraction_notes: No classification accuracy is reported; hardware correctness is shown by waveforms matching software predictions. Proposed designs are analogue mixed-signal simulations in Cadence Virtuoso (TSMC 65 nm); baselines are post-implementation digital designs. Throughput/energy are assumed to be for the Iris configuration (paper does not state otherwise). Tables III and IV read from rendered PDF page 6. Table III state-of-the-art baselines have dataset_id null.
